notes.title: 1.1 Update is here!
notes.notes:
Hi,

The update is here! Here's what in it:

 Fully reworked starting weapon system (now you choose characters with unique weapons and relics instead of just weapons!)
 4 new weapons
 9 new relics
 6 new mods
 3 new boss relics
 balance changes
 minor bug fixes and visual changes
 and other game changes


I also updated press kit with new update stuff! You can find it HERE!

REWORKED STARTING WEAPON SYSTEM
The reworked starting weapon system is definitely the most exciting part of this update! Now you choose characters instead of weapons! Each character has unique relic that changes game in big way and also unique weapon to start with! Weapons are very similar to old ones, but there are new ones too and old weapons got big buffs, so I would recommend trying all of them :)

NEW CONTENT
I won't spoil anything! Explore new upgrades by yourself. I will just mention that I designed all of them to make less popular build more interesting and fun.

GAME CHANGES

Mark damage bonus: 25% → 30%
Explosion, poison, lightning damage chance to trigger (on hit) effects: 35% → 50%
Added enemy health increase after boss fight to danger levels and decreased enemy health bonus (these changes will make first zone less tedious, but later ones will be much harder)
Made some trinkets a lot cheaper and some starting weapons (now characters) a bit more expensive
Small enemy changes


BALANCE CHANGES
Oh, boy, strap in!

WEAPONS

Bees!: range 18 → 35, piercing 0 → 4, damage 45 → 35, bullet speed 20 → 15, trigger chance 100% → 75%
Call of void: explosion damage 90 → 110, voidling damage 50 → 60
Garlic: poison stacks applied 4 → 3
Hunter arrows: damage 50 → 60, removed on deflect mark, added: deflected bullets have 20% chance to apply mark
Machine gun: max charge amount 15 → 20, attack speed 0.15 → 0.125
Thunder staff: complete rework: (on deflect): shoot bullet that will trigger chain lightning on enemy hit
Dev note: his will open up more opportunities for interesting combos)
Vulture: bullet damage 35 → 40, bullet count 6 → 7, critter spawn amount 4 → 3


RELICS

Ancient tome: remove speed penalty
Armed grenade: damage 40 → 50, bullet count 3 → 4, bullet piercing 0 → 1
Bloody scarf: added: +20% dash recharge speed and on kill effects will be triggered twice
Bouncy balls: damage 40 → 50
Bullet fries: max ammo -2 → -4
Destruction protocol: explosion size 2.5 → 3.25
Evil spirit: damage 40 → 50
Hive: on hurt critter amount 8 → 7
Shattered mirror: now effect will last for entire area instead of 3 seconds, spread 10 → 5, trigger chance 30% → 20%, added: -5% haste along side with +1 bullet
Thunder drums: removed lightning damage bonus, added: (on bat hit), trigger chain lightning


MODS

Barrage: chance to trigger 15% → 25%
Hamster wheel: removed range penalty
Laser marker: chance to mark 20% → 25%
Strange worm: added +1 bounce
Twin strike: range -25% → -15%


BOSS RELICS

Abyss Necklace: mark damage bonus +12% → +8%
Ancient Brew: dash recharge speed +45% → +60%
Ancient Cannonballs: spread -100% → -125%, bullet speed +25% → 35%, chance to give bonus damage +30% → +35%
Chaos in a bottle: explosion trigger chance 75% → 50%, explosion size 2.5 → 3, added: every 3.5s seconds, trigger chain lightning twice
Cursed blade: damage 50 → 65
Fate Breaker: added -20% enemy bullet speed and +35% knockback effects
Hell Tome: explosion size +60% → +100%
Jeff the Egg: added +25 flat spread
Master dagger: complete rework: (on dash): +8% critical hit chance, (on critical hit): deal triple damage, apply 4 stacks of poison and -2% critical hit chance
Perfect lightning bolt: mark duration bonus 1.25s → 0.5s, added: (on hit): if targets was marked, shoot bullets in random directions
Perfect sandwich: elite chance increase 100% → 20%. Chance will be increased immediately instead of after mod is applied.
Platinum sword: haste +40% → +35%
Royal wine: added: +25% poison damage and -25% poison tick speed. poison tick speed bonus for marked enemies +200% → +300%
Sacred scroll: lightning chance 40% → 30%
Dev note: relic description showed that chance was 50%, but the actual chance always been 40%


TRINKETS

Cursed gift: enemy health 15% → 8%
Helping hand: homing 12 → 15
Jester hat: relic options 2 → 3
Memories: relic will appear even more often
Royal ring: boss reward rerolls 4 → 5
Rusty wrench: remove haste penalty
Spear: damage -20% → -15%
Strange brew: heal chance 75% → 50%
Toolbox: mod rerolls 2 → 3



That's it! I hope you all will like it and definitely let me know what you think! Like I mentioned in previous post, I am still not sure if I will update game further, but who knows!

Thanks for all support,
Ravernt

notes.title: Upcoming Game Update Info + Patch Notes 1.0.10
notes.notes:
Hi there,

Just wanted to let all you know if I will update game further and the short answer is that at least one update is in the works!

It will be small update (so don't expect anything big) adding a bit more content as a thank you to you all for the support! Time to Strike isn't a massive success, but I'm very happy how launch went, so as a thank you I will be adding few more items that got cut from full release!

As of future update I'm not sure. I might from time to time add new weapons, relics, mods but no promises!

And also I updated game a bit, so that means Patch Notes!


 Timer is now paused while there are no enemies
 A bit more currency will be given after run, so you could unlock more exiting weapons, trinkets sooner
 Added information that any deflected bullet is affected by bat mods to Book of Forgotten Knowledge



Thanks for the support and have a great day,
Ravernt

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.9
notes.notes:
Correct Light Speed achievement time requirement from 6 minutes to 7 

Dev Note: Not that long ago, I released patch that lengthened time between enemy spawns and I hadn't considered how it will affect some achievements, so I'm trying fix my mistake. The previous achievement version was very RNG based and frustrating, so changes were needed.

notes.title: Time to Strike Release Date!
notes.notes:
Hi,

I will keep this post short and sweet. Time to Strike will be released on February 19th! After more than 7 months of work the game will be finally out! This is my first commercial game, so this is BIG milestone for me!

Thank you for the support through all development,
Ravernt

notes.title: Updated demo version is out!
notes.notes:
Hi,

I'm exited to announce that new demo version is out! I put a lot of effort to polish it as much as possible, so I hope you will enjoy it! This should be the final version of the demo, so next milestone will be full release!

Demo changes:

Game graphics were massively updated (at least in my opinion :) )
Elite enemies! Tougher enemy variations that sometimes spawn during waves
Boss relics! Unique relics that are obtained after boss fight (there are 4 in the demo, but I am planning to add at least 26 more for full release)
Some starting weapons/trinkets were changed
A lot of weapon/relic/mod reworks and balance changes
Bug fixes


As always, every bit of feedback is appreciated, so if you find a bug, think that something should change or have a great suggestion, feel free to let me know.

Thanks for reading and have a great day,
Ravernt
